## Delivery

**EMAIL_TRANSPORT chooses the route.**
- **'smtp'** (default) sends through the SMTP credential on Send Report SMTP, from SMTP_FROM to REPORT_EMAILS.
- **'administrate'** (anything other than 'smtp') sends through Administrate (bulkAdhocEmails.sendBulkContactAdhocEmail) from SENDING_ADDRESS_ID to the contacts in REPORT_CONTACT_IDS.

Both paths rejoin at IF Send Errors?, which catches a GraphQL refusal, an SMTP rejection, or a send where no recipient was accepted.

**Sender address.** Some SMTP providers (e.g. Google Workspace) rewrite the From header to the authenticated mailbox, so SMTP_FROM may not control the visible sender. Use a sending domain whose SPF/DKIM/DMARC records authorise your mail route, or messages may be silently dropped.

**There is no reply-to on the Administrate send mutation.** Replies go to the sending address.

**Check the digest in a real mail client before go-live.** Email HTML is table layout and inline styles only.

**An attached credential is not a working credential.** Send one manual run and read the response. Administrate returns refusals inside an HTTP 200.

## 4.0 Daily Reconciliation Report - Config

**LOOKBACK_HOURS** - hours of scans to include. 24 = the last day.
**DUP_THRESHOLD** - name-similarity cut-off for flagging possible duplicate people, 0 to 1. Higher = stricter, fewer flagged.
**REPORT_TITLE** - heading and subject-line prefix.
**GRAPHQL_URL** - Administrate endpoint used by Send Report.
**CHECKIN_LOG_TABLE_ID** - id of the EventCheckInLog Data Table that 3.0 writes.
**EMAIL_TRANSPORT** - 'smtp' or 'administrate'. See the Delivery sticky.
**SENDING_ADDRESS_ID** - the verified Administrate sending address id, Administrate route only.
**REPORT_CONTACT_IDS** - comma separated Administrate contact ids, Administrate route only.
**SMTP_FROM / REPORT_EMAILS** - sender and comma separated recipients, SMTP route only.
**SEND_ENABLED** - 'true' sends the report, 'false' builds it and sends nothing.

**Schedule.** Runs daily at 07:00 in the workflow's timezone (Workflow Settings, default Europe/London). Change the trigger or the timezone to suit.

**Empty days.** The report goes out every day with the counts in the subject line, so it can be cleared without opening. Silence would be indistinguishable from a broken scheduler.

**What it reads.** Every scan 3.0 handles writes one row to the check-in log, including refused ones. attendanceMark is exactly 'Present' when Administrate recorded attendance, otherwise 'blocked-<reason>'. Build Digest turns each reason into plain wording and shows the event title instead of the raw id. alwaysOutputData is on, so an empty table still produces a report.

**Caveat.** 3.0's ATTENDED controls whether Administrate records Present or Absent, but 3.0's Build Log Row writes 'Present' whenever check-in succeeded, regardless. With ATTENDED false this report says Present while Administrate says Absent. Leave ATTENDED alone unless you also change Build Log Row.

**Before go-live:** clear test rows from the check-in table. Delete the rows, never the table, since 3.0, 4.0 and 5.0 reference it by id.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation SendReport($contactIds: [String]!, $subject: String, $body: String, $sendingAddressId: ID){ bulkAdhocEmails { sendBulkContactAdhocEmail(input:{ contactIds:$contactIds, subject:$subject, body:$body, sendingAddressId:$sendingAddressId }){ errors { label message value } } } }', variables: { contactIds: String($('Config').item.json.REPORT_CONTACT_IDS || '').split(',').map(function (id) { return id.trim(); }).filter(function (id) { return id !== ''; }), subject: $json.subject, body: $json.html, sendingAddressId: $('Config').item.json.SENDING_ADDRESS_ID } }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: Daily reconciliation report was not sent: the send returned errors, or the mail server rejected every recipient.
